_purpose: Executable test cases (EC) for UC3 — runnable expansion of the scenarios. Per scenario: 1 success EC + exactly one alternative EC per expected.alternative[] entry.
_id_note: EC- = Executable Case. Chain: AC → SC → EC. (TC- = L3 condition; SC- = scenario.)

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-back at 1:00 while playing jumps to 0:50 and continues
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Play the video to 1:00 with the overlay visible
cases.expected_result: Playback jumps back exactly 10 seconds (1:00 → 0:50) and continues playing.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-back moves exactly 10s (not 9 or 11)
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Assert: position is exactly 0:20 — not 0:19 or 0:21
cases.expected_result: The skip moves by exactly 10s — not 9 or 11 (off-by-one guard).

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-forward at 1:00 while playing jumps to 1:10 and continues
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
cases.expected_result: Playback jumps forward exactly 10 seconds (1:00 → 1:10) and continues playing.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-forward moves exactly 10s (not 9 or 11)
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Assert: position is exactly 0:40 — not 0:39 or 0:41
cases.expected_result: The skip moves by exactly 10s — not 9 or 11 (off-by-one guard).

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-back at 0:05 while playing clamps to 0:00 and continues
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
cases.expected_result: Position clamps to 0:00 and playback continues (prior PLAYING state preserved — not force-paused).

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Position the video at 0:00 while playing
Assert: position stays 0:00 (never a negative value)
cases.expected_result: A skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00 — the position never resolves to a negative value.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-back at 0:05 while paused clamps to 0:00 and stays paused
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is paused
cases.expected_result: Position clamps to 0:00 and the media stays paused (prior PAUSED state preserved — not force-played).

cases.name: [Video player] Verify paused skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is paused
steps: Assert: position stays 0:00 (never a negative value)
cases.expected_result: A skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00 — the position never resolves to a negative value.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-forward near the end lands on the final frame in the end state
steps: Assert: position clamps to the final frame (2:00)
Assert: the player is in the end state (paused at the final frame)
cases.expected_result: Playback jumps to the final frame and enters the end state (paused at the final frame).

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-forward past the end does not loop to 0:00
steps: Assert: position does NOT wrap to 0:00
cases.expected_result: It does not loop back to 0:00.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip-forward past the end throws no error
steps: Assert: no error / crash is raised
cases.expected_result: It does not throw an error.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip while paused updates position and stays paused
cases.expected_result: The position updates by ±10s and the video remains paused.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip while paused never auto-resumes playback
steps: Assert: state is still paused (no implicit paused → playing transition)
cases.expected_result: Skip never triggers an implicit paused → playing transition (no auto-resume).

cases.name: [Live player] Verify a Live stream shows no in-app skip buttons
steps: Assert: the −10s / +10s buttons are NOT rendered
cases.expected_result: On an active Live stream the ±10s skip buttons are not shown (seeking not applicable in-app).

cases.name: [Video player] Verify a recorded LS shows the skip buttons (contrast)
steps: Mock: SDK stream type = recorded LS
Assert: the ±10s skip buttons ARE rendered
cases.expected_result: On a recorded LS the ±10s skip buttons ARE shown.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify a video shows the skip buttons (contrast)
steps: Assert: the ±10s skip buttons ARE rendered
cases.expected_result: On a video the ±10s skip buttons ARE shown.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify three quick +10 taps accumulate to 1:30 with a +10 icon each tap
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Assert: net position is 1:30 (each tap adds 10s)
Assert: the skip icon shows '+10' on every tap
cases.expected_result: Three quick +10 taps accumulate to 1:30, and the icon shows the per-tap value (+10) each time.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify three quick −10 taps accumulate to −30s
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
cases.expected_result: Three quick −10 taps accumulate to −30s.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify the skip icon never shows the accumulated total
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Assert: the icon text is '+10' on every tap and never '+30'
cases.expected_result: The icon never shows the accumulated total (never '+30').

cases.name: [Video player] Verify a rapid skip-back burst near the start clamps to 0:00 mid-burst
steps: Assert: position goes 0:05 then clamps to 0:00 mid-burst (never negative)
cases.expected_result: During a rapid burst near the start, taps accumulate until one would cross 0:00 — that tap clamps to 0:00, never negative, even mid-burst.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify a rapid skip-forward burst near the end stops at the final frame
steps: Assert: position stops at the final frame (2:00) mid-burst and never loops back to 0:00
cases.expected_result: A rapid burst near the end stops at the final frame mid-burst and never loops back to 0:00.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify no skip buttons before the overlay is revealed
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is loaded
the UC1a controls overlay has not been revealed
steps: Load the video player without tapping
Assert: no skip buttons are visible
cases.expected_result: No skip buttons are visible until the controls overlay is revealed.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip buttons appear after the overlay is revealed
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is loaded
steps: Tap to reveal the controls overlay (UC1a)
Assert: the skip buttons now appear
cases.expected_result: After revealing the overlay (UC1a) the skip buttons appear (transition guard).

cases.name: [Video player] Verify skip while buffering on mobile seeks and rebuffers at the target
preconditions: the video is buffering at the current position
steps: Mock: throttle the network to force buffering
Assert: the player seeks to the target and rebuffers there (loading shown), then resumes — no stuck spinner, no crash
cases.expected_result: On mobile, tapping a skip button while buffering seeks to the target and rebuffers there — surfacing loading feedback, never a silent frozen frame.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify a buffering skip never leaves a frozen frame without feedback
steps: Assert: an explicit loading state is shown throughout (never a silent frozen frame)
cases.expected_result: The viewer is never left on a frozen frame with no feedback.

cases.name: [Video player] Verify web buffering shows Reconnecting UI and keeps manual scrub available
preconditions: the video is buffering at the current position
steps: Assert: manual scrub/scroll remains available (no silent frozen frame)
cases.expected_result: The web player surfaces the 'Reconnecting' UI and keeps manual scrub/scroll available — the viewer is never left on a silent frozen frame (BR-15).

cases.name: [Video player] Observe the ±10s skip result mid-buffer on web (do NOT assert — FU-3)
steps: Observe and record the outcome (screenshot + notes)
cases.expected_result: OBSERVE/RECORD ONLY — the exact ±10s-skip result mid-buffer on web is unconfirmed; do NOT assert until Web Engineering closes FU-3.
